title: Prediction Markets at TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026
tagline: The unofficial directory of prediction-market events, sessions, companies and people across TOKEN2049 week.

open_questions.detail: The organiser currently indicates 20:00. Recheck the final-week agenda.
Official TOKEN2049 Week shows 19:30; some mirror listings have shown 20:00.

open_questions.item: Ripple x Citadel Securities Sundown Mixer
open_questions.detail: No first-party invite or event page found. Treat as unconfirmed.

open_questions.item: Prediction Market Traders Night (Moirai): who attends
open_questions.detail: The public description is thin and the attendee profile is not public.
No prediction-market market makers, data or execution firms are confirmed.
We don't publish activity figures here. See Hyperliquid's filing and announcements, and note the difference between organic and incentive-driven activity.
An available integration is not the same as adoption.
Kalshi Klear's request to margin event contracts for qualifying participants has been reported. Check the CFTC status before relying on it.
FT reporting on Polymarket seeking financial-product treatment. Regulators' positions are not settled.
We use the current organiser bio. Reconfirm close to The Odds.
CJ Hetherington, Matt Restivo and Pär Helgosson are linked to The Odds in our research. Check the organiser page for the final line-up.

open_questions.item: Named Polymarket staff at the Kick-Off
open_questions.detail: The event is confirmed (hosted by 528 Collective). Shayne Coplan is confirmed in Singapore via TOKEN2049. No public roster of Polymarket staff attending the party has been found.

Limitless, Myriad, Opinion Labs, Azuro, Novig, ProphetX, Hedgehog, Mimir, Susquehanna Crypto, GSR and Jump: no current public evidence of TOKEN2049 Singapore attendance yet. Tarek Mansour isn’t listed just because Kalshi is present.
Session reported in our sweep; organiser page not yet linked.
Tom Wolf, CJ Hetherington, Matt Restivo, Pär Helgosson and Jacelynn Pang are shown as Unverified. They came from research leads without a public source link.

open_questions.item: HYPE Singapore (6–7 Oct): event pages offline
open_questions.detail: Hype Global’s HYPE Singapore page and its Luma registration page both returned “not found” on 23 September. The homepage still promotes a Singapore event but gives no date. Not known whether it has moved, been cancelled or is being republished.
Hours (09:00–17:00) and format were reported by Hype Global, but that page is now offline. The venue still isn’t published.

practical.title: Media accreditation deadline
practical.body: TOKEN2049 says media accreditation must be submitted before 12:00 SGT on 1 October. Processing can take up to five working days, and there is no onsite accreditation.

practical.title: Times are Singapore time
practical.body: All times are SGT (UTC+8). Programmes change, so recheck agendas 24–48 hours before you travel to an event.
